headless.note: Framework staging is repository-owned and fail-closed offline. Command-line snesref remains headless; the native game runner intentionally treats system SDL2 as a host prerequisite and configures SDL3 fetching off.

purpose: Pinned SNESRecomp framework staged from the repository-owned source archive. UR-Recomp's permanent native build uses host SDL2, disables SDL3 source fetching, carries a narrow project patch for exact neutral controller-stream replay, exposes the existing host-owned pause gate for modern session control, and exposes the framework's guest-frame APU timing lock needed by deterministic host-owned race restart.
